newsitem.title: CHINA: Bank lends Shanghai Petrochemical 270 mln yuan.
newsitem.headline: Bank lends Shanghai Petrochemical 270 mln yuan.

text.p: The Industrial and Commercial Bank of China has granted a 270 million yuan (32.5 million) preferential loan to Shanghai Petrochemical Co, the Xinhua news agency said on Thursday.
Shanghai Petrochemical had entered a critical period of growth, with ethylene production capacity expected to reach 1.0 million tonnes by 2000, Xinhua quoted a company spokesman as saying.
It gave no details of the terms of the loan.
"Shanghai Petrochemical is short of capital and the bank loan will certainly breathe fresh air into the company," the official agency quoted an unnamed analyst as saying.
